question.en: How do you want the voice for this video?

elevenlabs.key_steps: Create it at https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys with Text to Speech, Voices (Read), Sound Effects, Music and User (Read, for the credits check). Save it yourself as ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=... in the video folder's .env, or once for all projects in ~/.config/motion-studio/.env (Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.config\motion-studio\.env). Never paste it in chat.
elevenlabs.cost_note: Free plan: 10k credits/month, personal use only, no PCM/music on some tiers (the scripts fall back to MP3). Models: Hebrew -> eleven_v4 (default) / eleven_v4_turbo / eleven_v3; English -> eleven_multilingual_v2 (default) or eleven_v4. eleven_multilingual_v2 and flash_v2_5 do NOT speak Hebrew.

offline_hebrew_note: No offline Hebrew voice ships with this skill. If you need one, Phonikud TTS (open source, Piper-based) can generate the WAV; then run align.py --lang he for word timings.
